isatis_tinctoria.Багрилни качества:
Process: a reduction indigo vat; do not use the ordinary „decoction plus mordant“ schema.
Mordant: no classic metal mordant is needed.
pH: the reduction vat is alkaline, and controlling the pH is part of the process.
Temperature: depends on the method of extraction and reduction chosen; no single range applies as it does for the yellow dyes.
isatis_tinctoria.Багрилна съставка: The leaves contain indoxyl precursors such as indican and isatan. Hydrolysis releases indoxyl, which oxidises into insoluble indigo. In a reduction vat the indigo is temporarily brought into a soluble form, enters the fibre, and turns blue again on contact with air.
isatis_tinctoria.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: in the first year, while the plant is still a rosette of leaves; best in summer, before the flower stem forms. Once flowering begins the indigo precursors fall away.
What is gathered: the leaves.
Processing: for fresh extraction, use as soon after cutting as possible. For historic processing the leaves can be worked into a paste or balls; this is a different process from an ordinary dye decoction.
Storage: fresh leaves do not keep; for dried or fermented material, follow the particular indigo process.
isatis_tinctoria.Как се държи: The leaves are a source of indigo precursors and are not used as an ordinary hot dye bath. The blue comes from a particular process of extraction, reduction and then oxidation on the fibre.

juglans_regia.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: not required; alum can clear the tone, iron takes it very dark.
pH: neutral is a dependable start.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Cellulose: the high tannin content means a separate tannin pre-bath is often unnecessary.
juglans_regia.Багрилна съставка: Walnut hulls, leaves and bark contain juglone and a considerable quantity of tannins and other polyphenols. The juglone gives the characteristic brown; the tannins give substantivity and a strong reaction with iron.
juglans_regia.Как се държи: The green hulls are the strongest dye part and give light through to very dark brown; leaves and bark are gentler. Walnut is strongly substantive and can dye without a metal mordant.
juglans_regia.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: green hulls — as the nuts ripen or fall; leaves — sound and grown during the active season; bark — only from prunings or waste material.
What is used: green hulls, leaves, and bark if needed.
Processing: the hulls can be used fresh, frozen or dried; wear gloves, they stain strongly.
Storage: dried material — dark and dry; fresh material — frozen or used soon.

lavandula_angustifolia.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for lighter yellow-beiges; iron very sparingly.
pH: the flower pigments are pH-sensitive and not especially fast.
Temperature: moderate; a hard, long boil does the colour no good.
Status: an experimental or local dye plant rather than a staple.
lavandula_angustifolia.Багрилна съставка: Lavender contains flavonoids, phenolic acids, and in the flowers a little anthocyanin pigment. Water extraction takes mainly the yellow-brown phenolic fraction; the aromatic essential oils are not significant textile dyes.
lavandula_angustifolia.Как се държи: The flowers and leaves give pale grey-yellows, beiges and sometimes experimental lilac casts. Do not expect a lasting lavender purple from a water bath.
lavandula_angustifolia.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flowers · leaves.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.

malus_domestica.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for yellow-beige; iron for grey or brown.
pH: neutral is a dependable start.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Eco print: the leaves can give a soft outline; the strength depends on the season and the variety.
malus_domestica.Багрилна съставка: The leaves and bark contain flavonoids, procyanidins and tannin polyphenols. They give the yellow-brown range and form darker complexes with iron.
malus_domestica.Как се държи: Leaves and bark give yellow-beige through light brown. It is worth having as an easily found local material and for gentle natural tones.
malus_domestica.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: leaves — sound and fully grown during the active season; bark — best taken as prunings or from fallen or cut branches.
What is used: leaves · bark.
Processing: use the leaves fresh or dry them in the shade; chop the bark small before extracting.
Storage: fully dry and dark. Never ring-strip bark from a living tree.

mespilus_germanica.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a warmer brown; iron for grey or dark.
pH: neutral suits it.
Temperature: hot extraction.
Eco print: the leaves can give a tannin outline, but the strength varies with the season.
mespilus_germanica.Багрилна съставка: The leaves and bark contain polyphenols and tannins. The tannin fraction accounts for the brown ground and the darkening with iron; how much there is varies with the part and the maturity of the plant.
mespilus_germanica.Как се държи: Leaves and bark give honey-browns and muted beige-browns. The material is tannic, but local and seasonal rather than a standardised source for a pre-bath.
mespilus_germanica.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: leaves — sound and fully grown during the active season; bark — only from prunings, fallen or already cut branches.
What is used: leaves · bark.
Processing: use the leaves fresh or dry them in the shade; chop the bark small before extracting.
Storage: fully dry, in the dark. Never ring-strip bark from a living tree.

origanum_vulgare.Багрилни качества:
Mordant: alum for a lighter gold; iron to darken.
pH: neutral is a good starting point.
Temperature: moderate hot extraction.
Status: a secondary or experimental dye plant.
origanum_vulgare.Багрилна съставка: Oregano is rich in phenolic acids and flavonoids. These water-soluble polyphenols give the golden-brown range; the essential oils are not the main textile colourant.
origanum_vulgare.Как се държи: The aerial parts give golds through to reddish browns. The dye strength is moderate, and the plant is more interesting as an easily available local or garden material than as a classic strong dye.
origanum_vulgare.Беритба и обработка:
When to gather: on a dry day, when the flowers or flower heads are fully out; for the most even material, choose sound, unwilted plants.
What is gathered: flowers · leaves · the aerial parts.
Processing: use fresh, or spread in a thin layer and dry in the shade with good air movement.
Storage: once fully dry — dark and dry, in a paper bag or a closed container.
